_source.title: 隐藏开始页支持信息悬浮组件
_source.remarks.text.0: 隐藏开始页右侧悬浮组件（微信、客服、电话、反馈）
_source.remarks.text.1: 注意 1：本接口需要使用者启用扩展的外部交互权限，如若未启用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.remarks.text.2: 注意 2：本接口为私有化部署版本专用接口，如若在其它版本调用将始终 `throw Error`

title: Hide the start page support information floating components
remarks.text.0: Hide the floating components on the right side of the start page (WeChat, customer service, phone, feedback)
remarks.text.1: Note 1: This API requires the user to enable the extension external interaction permission, if not enabled, it will always `throw Error`
remarks.text.2: Note 2: This API is dedicated to the private deployment edition. Calling it in other editions will always `throw Error`
